//: A lane light in the middle of a flicker. EOC_BR1_LIGHTS_FLICKER turns it back into t_strconc_floor_olight a few seconds later.
name: concrete floor, flickering light
description: Concrete under a ceiling light that has just cut out.  The tube ticks and buzzes.  It will probably come back on.

//: A lobby light during a blackout (EOC_BR1_LOBBY_BLACKOUT). Comes back as t_br1_lobby_light.
name: lobby floor, dead panel
description: Clean concrete under a panel light that has gone out.  All of them went out at once.

//: Each lit lane light has a 3 in 100 chance to cut out. Lobby and generator lights have their own ids and are left alone.
Each lit lane light near the player has a 1 in 150 chance to die for good. Run every 6 hours: around half the lights you live near are dead after a month.
Every 5-15 minutes on Level 1, some lit lane lights within 20 tiles cut out for 2-3 seconds. Each flicker is a real map change, so it stays close to the player.

then.u_message: Overhead, a light buzzes and stutters.

//: Every 6 hours on Level 1, a few lit lane lights within 30 tiles die for good (t_br1_dead_light). The generator can still relight them for a week at a time.

then.u_message: Somewhere in the lanes, a tube pops and fizzles out.

//: Rarely, while the player is in an elevator lobby, every lobby light dies at once for 30-60 minutes. Sometimes a Smiler comes to the dark.

effect.message: Every light in the lobby dies at once, with a sound like a breath going out.  The hum stops.  In the dark you can hear the lift cables creak.
